drafted_from: tool:change-speed-over-a-range's own row in tools/media-composition/tool-rows.json, tools/media-composition/do-work/change-speed-over-a-range.mjs, and the script run on a synthetic 7 second clip
start_here: Say to your AI: "Play seconds 2 to 4 of my video at half speed and keep everything else." It runs tool:change-speed-over-a-range and saves the new video in your files.
no_lists_because: It makes a new video in your files from the video you name and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Find your video's identity in your files, and the time in seconds of the moment to slow (tool:find-action-moments finds one).
2. Say "Slow seconds 2 to 4 to half speed" with from, to and speed (0.1 to 10; 0.5 is half speed, 2 is double). Add keep_from and keep_to to keep only a window around it.

3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run and tool tool:change-speed-over-a-range. The door runs it in a container and answers {"result": {...}}; an error comes back as {"error": "what to change"}.
4. Read result.duration_seconds (it grows when you slow a stretch) and files.video, the new video in your files.
